{{Quote|Well, whatever Matrin's doing here, we can guess what happened to the Rebels. They musta cleared out. We'll hear from 'em once they find a new hideout.|Han Solo|<ref name="marvel70" />}}
[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] '''Pejanes Kindar''' was an officer in the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]] by the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], where he was assigned to an outpost on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stenos/Legends|Stenos]]. Kindar soon began to suspect that a valuable artifact was concealed within the Rebels' Stenos hideaway, which was located within an ancient temple atop a tall mountain covered in inscrutable hieroglyphs.<ref name="marvel70" /> Kindar fled Stenos when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] moved in on the world<ref name="cswe">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]&mdash;Rebel command sent a team led by Yavin heroes [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] to investigate and check in with Kindar when they missed their routine check-in, but they found that Kindar's outpost was instead occupied by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] gang led by ruffian [[Rik Duel/Legends|Rik Duel]]. Claiming that Kindar had tasked him and his friends with finding the artifact within the temple, Duel convinced the Rebels to aid in his search&mdash;however, after unearthing the lost statue of the [[Stenax]] god [[Vol]], Duel revealed that he was instead secretly working for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="marvel70" />
